newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Cocoa may not overcome 1,035 stg barrier.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Cocoa may not overcome 1,035 stg barrier.

text.p: JULY Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
LIFFE cocoa futures are unlikely to overcome the immediate 1,035 stg hurdle as the market retraces further from last week's rally, technical analysts said on Tuesday.
But support is seen intact at 1,010, basis July.
The market was due six to seven stg down at the open, traders said.
Elli Gifford, an independent technical analyst, said the 1,035 stg mark, last week's ceiling, was now seen as the main upside target.
"But with the rally running out of steam, I don't think the resistance will be overcome," she said.
On the downside, support is seen at 1,020, 1,010, 1,005 and 995 stg. July hit a low of 1,008 on May 21.
"The support at 1,010 will probably hold but the market won't take out the resistance," Gifford added.
The 14-day relative strength indicator of overbought/oversold conditions is at a neutral 53 percent.
Cocoa hit a high of 1,065 in early April. Since then, there have been several failed attempts to try to test that level.
